text:
alex: quick design check — thinking about lightweight header-driven route hints so REST clients can opt into routing/quotas without client codegen. idea: small set of headers that the edge router consumes and maps to internal route ids and quota keys.
maria: can you sketch the headers? curious about security & spoofing.
alex: sketch below — header names `X-RW-Route`, `X-RW-Quota-Key`, `X-RW-Canary` (optional). edge verifies route->permission via token introspection. example: 
```
POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
Host: inference.redwood.internal
Authorization: Bearer <token>
X-RW-Route: model.generate
X-RW-Quota-Key: org:acme-payments
X-RW-Canary: canary-42
{ "prompt": "Summarize..." }
```
jordan: i like the simplicity. questions: how do we keep proto-first teams happy? we still need canonical mapping in our route registry (proto_service.method <-> route id). suggestion: route registry is the source of truth and edge uses route id from header or falls back to lookup by path+method.
sam: for quotas we need clear semantics: quota-key must map to tenant_id for metering, but allow an override for per-route aggregation (team-level buckets). also: console should show per-route and per-quota breakdowns — not just per-token.
lucy: telemetry note — ensure trace id propagation and sampled debug flag. propose `X-RW-Trace` (optional) and `X-RW-Debug` for full-sample when customer enables a debug session in console. console can inject a short-lived signed debug token to avoid spoofing.
maria: signed headers ftw. if edge accepts header hints, edge must validate HMAC or opaque signed claim so untrusted clients can't claim higher quota.
alex: agreed. plan: edge verifies header signature with customer key (KMS-stored binding) or uses introspection that returns allowed routes/quotas. will include fallback: no header => do lookup by path or client metadata.
jordan: fallback mapping should prefer explicit header mapping. Also add an assertion in control plane to reject mismatched header->proto mappings during canary.
sam: on console UX — mockups: show a route page with columns: calls/min, p50/p95 latency, quota usage (daily/monthly), errors, last canary id. users can open a 'debug session' which generates a signed short header `X-RW-Debug-Token`.
alex: nice. i'm worried about per-request overhead for signature verification. maybe cache signature validation keys per-tenant and accept short TTLs.
lucy: sampling: let router attach `route_hint_sampling=1` metric and emit `route_hint_accept/reject` events so we can measure adoption. also add `route_liveness` gauge for routes that are falling back often.
maria: what about REST <-> gRPC translation — do we add a JSON envelope fallback for older clients so we don't require client changes?
jordan: yes: two-layer strategy: 1) recommended: header-driven explicit mapping to proto, low overhead; 2) compatibility: JSON envelope mapping (path->proto) for legacy clients. Envelope would look like { "_route": "model.generate", "payload": { ... } } and be treated as lower trust.
sam: need to document quota resolution priority: explicit header quota-key > token-derived tenant > path-derived default. add tests for multi-tenant edge cases.
deploy-bot: router-proxy v2 canary deployed to staging (canary-42) — logs: route-hints enabled.
alex: perfect timing — can we run a quick perf sweep in staging? specifically signature verify costs + trace propagation overhead.
lucy: i'll add trace sampling toggles and dashboard panels. propose metrics: `rw.router.route_hint.accepted`, `rw.router.route_hint.rejected`, `rw.router.quota.binds`, `rw.router.quota.errors`, plus `rw.route.latency.p95_by_route`.
maria: one more: we should avoid header proliferation. limit to ~5 hints (route, quota, canary, trace, debug-token). keep naming consistent with Console UX.
jordan: agreed. can we add a lint in control plane that flags routes without canonical proto mapping? prevents orphan route ids.
alex: action items: i'll write a short RFC with the header spec, security model, and fallback rules. sam to draft quota resolution pseudocode and console columns. lucy to add telemetry metric list and dashboard sketch. jordan to propose control-plane linter rule. i'll post RFC by EOW. :+1:
